title: A finite quasi-coherent algebra is a directed colimit of finite finitely presented algebras with surjective transition maps
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a finite quasi-coherent algebra on a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme is a directed colimit of finite and finitely presented quasi-coherent algebras with surjective transition maps (statement lines 3597-3605). The proof (proof lines 3607-3638) presents the algebra as a quotient of the symmetric algebra on a finitely presented module, approximates the kernel by finite type submodules to obtain finitely presented approximants, and uses monic relations over a finite affine cover to make them finite. H3: a three-step construction with a finiteness argument at the end, written out in full.
